description: This Java abstract class 'Shelf' models a user's book shelf in a book tracking application. It includes fields for user association and shelf name, constructors, and overrides for equality and hash code methods.

classes.name: Shelf
classes.description: Abstract class representing a shelf belonging to a user, with properties for user and shelf name.

methods.name: Shelf
methods.description: Constructor initializing shelf name and associated user.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Sets the user reference to null, effectively dissociating the shelf from its user.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to define equality based on user and shelf name.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on user and shelf name.
